verses.ar: اِحْمَدُوا ٱلرَّبَّ لِأَنَّهُ صَالِحٌ، لِأَنَّ إِلَى ٱلْأَبَدِ رَحْمَتَهُ.
verses.kjv: O give thanks unto the LORD, for [he is] good: for his mercy [endureth] for ever.
verses.web: Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
verses.he: הֹד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה כִּי־טֹ֑וב כִּ֖י לְעֹולָ֣ם חַסְדֹּֽו׃

verses.ar: لِيَقُلْ مَفْدِيُّو ٱلرَّبِّ، ٱلَّذِينَ فَدَاهُمْ مِنْ يَدِ ٱلْعَدُوِّ،
verses.kjv: Let the redeemed of the LORD say [so], whom he hath redeemed from the hand of the enemy;
verses.web: Let the redeemed by Yahweh say so, whom he has redeemed from the hand of the adversary,
verses.he: יֹ֭אמְרוּ גְּאוּלֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר גְּ֝אָלָ֗ם מִיַּד־צָֽר׃

verses.ar: وَمِنَ ٱلْبُلْدَانِ جَمَعَهُمْ، مِنَ ٱلْمَشْرِقِ وَمِنَ ٱلْمَغْرِبِ، مِنَ ٱلشِّمَالِ وَمِنَ ٱلْبَحْرِ.
verses.kjv: And gathered them out of the lands, from the east, and from the west, from the north, and from the south.
verses.web: and gathered out of the lands, from the east and from the west, from the north and from the south.
verses.he: וּֽמֵאֲרָצֹ֗ות קִ֫בְּצָ֥ם מִמִּזְרָ֥ח וּמִֽמַּעֲרָ֑ב מִצָּפֹ֥ון וּמִיָּֽם׃

verses.ar: تَاهُوا فِي ٱلْبَرِّيَّةِ فِي قَفْرٍ بِلَا طَرِيقٍ. لَمْ يَجِدُوا مَدِينَةَ سَكَنٍ.
verses.kjv: They wandered in the wilderness in a solitary way; they found no city to dwell in.
verses.web: They wandered in the wilderness in a desert way. They found no city to live in.
verses.he: תָּע֣וּ בַ֭מִּדְבָּר בִּישִׁימֹ֣ון דָּ֑רֶךְ עִ֥יר מֹ֝ושָׁ֗ב לֹ֣א מָצָֽאוּ׃

verses.ar: جِيَاعٌ عِطَاشٌ أَيْضًا أَعْيَتْ أَنْفُسُهُمْ فِيهِمْ.
verses.kjv: Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them.
verses.web: Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them.
verses.he: רְעֵבִ֥ים גַּם־צְמֵאִ֑ים נַ֝פְשָׁ֗ם בָּהֶ֥ם תִּתְעַטָּֽף׃

verses.ar: فَصَرَخُوا إِلَى ٱلرَّبِّ فِي ضِيقِهِمْ، فَأَنْقَذَهُمْ مِنْ شَدَائِدِهِمْ،
verses.kjv: Then they cried unto the LORD in their trouble, [and] he delivered them out of their distresses.
verses.web: Then they cried to Yahweh in their trouble, and he delivered them out of their distresses.
verses.he: וַיִּצְעֲק֣וּ אֶל־יְ֭הוָה בַּצַּ֣ר לָהֶ֑ם מִ֝מְּצֽוּקֹותֵיהֶ֗ם יַצִּילֵֽם׃

verses.ar: وَهَدَاهُمْ طَرِيقًا مُسْتَقِيمًا لِيَذْهَبُوا إِلَى مَدِينَةِ سَكَنٍ.
verses.kjv: And he led them forth by the right way, that they might go to a city of habitation.
verses.web: He led them also by a straight way, that they might go to a city to live in.
verses.he: וַ֭יּֽ͏ַדְרִיכֵם בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ יְשָׁרָ֑ה לָ֝לֶ֗כֶת אֶל־עִ֥יר מֹושָֽׁב׃

verses.ar: فَلْيَحْمَدُوا ٱلرَّبَّ عَلَى رَحْمَتِهِ وَعَجَائِبِهِ لِبَنِي آدَمَ.
verses.kjv: Oh that [men] would praise the LORD [for] his goodness, and [for] his wonderful works to the children of men!
verses.web: Let them praise Yahweh for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!
verses.he: יֹוד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה חַסְדֹּ֑ו וְ֝נִפְלְאֹותָ֗יו לִבְנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃

verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُ أَشْبَعَ نَفْسًا مُشْتَهِيَةً وَمَلَأَ نَفْسًا جَائِعَةً خَيْرًا،
verses.kjv: For he satisfieth the longing soul, and filleth the hungry soul with goodness.
verses.web: For he satisfies the longing soul. He fills the hungry soul with good.
verses.he: כִּי־הִ֭שְׂבִּיעַ נֶ֣פֶשׁ שֹׁקֵקָ֑ה וְנֶ֥פֶשׁ רְ֝עֵבָה מִלֵּא־טֹֽוב׃

verses.ar: ٱلْجُلُوسَ فِي ٱلظُّلْمَةِ وَظِلَالِ ٱلْمَوْتِ، مُوثَقِينَ بِٱلذُّلِّ وَٱلْحَدِيدِ.
verses.kjv: Such as sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, [being] bound in affliction and iron;
verses.web: Some sat in darkness and in the shadow of death, being bound in affliction and iron,
verses.he: יֹ֭שְׁבֵי חֹ֣שֶׁךְ וְצַלְמָ֑וֶת אֲסִירֵ֖י עֳנִ֣י וּבַרְזֶֽל׃

verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُمْ عَصَوْا كَلَامَ ٱللهِ، وَأَهَانُوا مَشُورَةَ ٱلْعَلِيِّ.
verses.kjv: Because they rebelled against the words of God, and contemned the counsel of the most High:
verses.web: because they rebelled against the words of God, and condemned the counsel of the Most High.
verses.he: כִּֽי־הִמְר֥וּ אִמְרֵי־אֵ֑ל וַעֲצַ֖ת עֶלְיֹ֣ון נָאָֽצוּ׃

verses.ar: فَأَذَلَّ قُلُوبَهُمْ بِتَعَبٍ. عَثَرُوا وَلَا مَعِينَ.
verses.kjv: Therefore he brought down their heart with labour; they fell down, and [there was] none to help.
verses.web: Therefore he brought down their heart with labor. They fell down, and there was no one to help.
verses.he: וַיַּכְנַ֣ע בֶּעָמָ֣ל לִבָּ֑ם כָּ֝שְׁל֗וּ וְאֵ֣ין עֹזֵֽר׃

verses.ar: ثُمَّ صَرَخُوا إِلَى ٱلرَّبِّ فِي ضِيقِهِمْ، فَخَلَّصَهُمْ مِنْ شَدَائِدِهِمْ.
verses.kjv: Then they cried unto the LORD in their trouble, [and] he saved them out of their distresses.
verses.web: Then they cried to Yahweh in their trouble, and he saved them out of their distresses.
verses.he: וַיִּזְעֲק֣וּ אֶל־יְ֭הוָה בַּצַּ֣ר לָהֶ֑ם מִ֝מְּצֻֽקֹותֵיהֶ֗ם יֹושִׁיעֵֽם׃

verses.ar: أَخْرَجَهُمْ مِنَ ٱلظُّلْمَةِ وَظِلَالِ ٱلْمَوْتِ، وَقَطَّعَ قُيُودَهُمْ.
verses.kjv: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and brake their bands in sunder.
verses.web: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and broke away their chains.
verses.he: יֹֽ֭וצִיאֵם מֵחֹ֣שֶׁךְ וְצַלְמָ֑וֶת וּמֹוסְרֹ֖ותֵיהֶ֣ם יְנַתֵּֽק׃

verses.ar: فَلْيَحْمَدُوا ٱلرَّبَّ عَلَى رَحْمَتِهِ وَعَجَائِبِهِ لِبَنِي آدَمَ.
verses.kjv: Oh that [men] would praise the LORD [for] his goodness, and [for] his wonderful works to the children of men!
verses.web: Let them praise Yahweh for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!
verses.he: יֹוד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה חַסְדֹּ֑ו וְ֝נִפְלְאֹותָ֗יו לִבְנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃

verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُ كَسَّرَ مَصَارِيعَ نُحَاسٍ، وَقَطَّعَ عَوَارِضَ حَدِيدٍ.
verses.kjv: For he hath broken the gates of brass, and cut the bars of iron in sunder.
verses.web: For he has broken the gates of bronze, and cut through bars of iron.
verses.he: כִּֽי־שִׁ֭בַּר דַּלְתֹ֣ות נְחֹ֑שֶׁת וּבְרִיחֵ֖י בַרְזֶ֣ל גִּדֵּֽעַ׃

verses.ar: وَٱلْجُهَّالُ مِنْ طَرِيقِ مَعْصِيَتِهِمْ، وَمِنْ آثَامِهِمْ يُذَلُّونَ.
verses.kjv: Fools because of their transgression, and because of their iniquities, are afflicted.
verses.web: Fools are afflicted because of their disobedience, and because of their iniquities.
verses.he: אֱ֭וִלִים מִדֶּ֣רֶךְ פִּשְׁעָ֑ם וּֽ֝מֵעֲוֹֽנֹתֵיהֶ֗ם יִתְעַנּֽוּ׃

verses.ar: كَرِهَتْ أَنْفُسُهُمْ كُلَّ طَعَامٍ، وَٱقْتَرَبُوا إِلَى أَبْوَابِ ٱلْمَوْتِ.
verses.kjv: Their soul abhorreth all manner of meat; and they draw near unto the gates of death.
verses.web: Their soul abhors all kinds of food. They draw near to the gates of death.
verses.he: כָּל־אֹ֭כֶל תְּתַעֵ֣ב נַפְשָׁ֑ם וַ֝יַּגִּ֗יעוּ עַד־שַׁ֥עֲרֵי מָֽוֶת׃

verses.ar: فَصَرَخُوا إِلَى ٱلرَّبِّ فِي ضِيقِهِمْ، فَخَلَّصَهُمْ مِنْ شَدَائِدِهِمْ.
verses.kjv: Then they cry unto the LORD in their trouble, [and] he saveth them out of their distresses.
verses.web: Then they cry to Yahweh in their trouble, and he saves them out of their distresses.
verses.he: וַיִּזְעֲק֣וּ אֶל־יְ֭הוָה בַּצַּ֣ר לָהֶ֑ם מִ֝מְּצֻֽקֹותֵיהֶ֗ם יֹושִׁיעֵֽם׃

verses.ar: أَرْسَلَ كَلِمَتَهُ فَشَفَاهُمْ، وَنَجَّاهُمْ مِنْ تَهْلُكَاتِهِمْ.
verses.kjv: He sent his word, and healed them, and delivered [them] from their destructions.
verses.web: He sends his word, and heals them, and delivers them from their graves.
verses.he: יִשְׁלַ֣ח דְּ֭בָרֹו וְיִרְפָּאֵ֑ם וִֽ֝ימַלֵּ֗ט מִשְּׁחִיתֹותָֽם׃ ׆

verses.ar: فَلْيَحْمَدُوا ٱلرَّبَّ عَلَى رَحْمَتِهِ وَعَجَائِبِهِ لِبَنِي آدَمَ.
verses.kjv: Oh that [men] would praise the LORD [for] his goodness, and [for] his wonderful works to the children of men!
verses.web: Let them praise Yahweh for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!
verses.he: יֹוד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה חַסְדֹּ֑ו וְ֝נִפְלְאֹותָ֗יו לִבְנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃ ׆

verses.ar: وَلْيَذْبَحُوا لَهُ ذَبَائِحَ ٱلْحَمْدِ، وَلْيَعُدُّوا أَعْمَالَهُ بِتَرَنُّمٍ.
verses.kjv: And let them sacrifice the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his works with rejoicing.
verses.web: Let them offer the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his deeds with singing.
verses.he: וְ֭יִזְבְּחוּ זִבְחֵ֣י תֹודָ֑ה וִֽיסַפְּר֖וּ מַעֲשָׂ֣יו בְּרִנָּֽה׃ ׆

verses.ar: اَلنَّازِلُونَ إِلَى ٱلْبَحْرِ فِي ٱلسُّفُنِ، ٱلْعَامِلُونَ عَمَلًا فِي ٱلْمِيَاهِ ٱلْكَثِيرَةِ،
verses.kjv: They that go down to the sea in ships, that do business in great waters;
verses.web: Those who go down to the sea in ships, who do business in great waters,
verses.he: יֹורְדֵ֣י הַ֭יָּם בָּאֳנִיֹּ֑ות עֹשֵׂ֥י מְ֝לָאכָ֗ה בְּמַ֣יִם רַבִּֽים׃ ׆

verses.ar: هُمْ رَأَوْا أَعْمَالَ ٱلرَّبِّ وَعَجَائِبَهُ فِي ٱلْعُمْقِ.
verses.kjv: These see the works of the LORD, and his wonders in the deep.
verses.web: these see Yahweh’s deeds, and his wonders in the deep.
verses.he: הֵ֣מָּה רָ֭אוּ מַעֲשֵׂ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְ֝נִפְלְאֹותָ֗יו בִּמְצוּלָֽה׃ ׆

verses.ar: أَمَرَ فَأَهَاجَ رِيحًا عَاصِفَةً فَرَفَعَتْ أَمْوَاجَهُ.
verses.kjv: For he commandeth, and raiseth the stormy wind, which lifteth up the waves thereof.
verses.web: For he commands, and raises the stormy wind, which lifts up its waves.
verses.he: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר וַֽ֭יַּעֲמֵד ר֣וּחַ סְעָרָ֑ה וַתְּרֹומֵ֥ם גַּלָּֽיו׃ ׆

verses.ar: يَصْعَدُونَ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ، يَهْبِطُونَ إِلَى ٱلْأَعْمَاقِ. ذَابَتْ أَنْفُسُهُمْ بِٱلشَّقَاءِ.
verses.kjv: They mount up to the heaven, they go down again to the depths: their soul is melted because of trouble.
verses.web: They mount up to the sky; they go down again to the depths. Their soul melts away because of trouble.
verses.he: יַעֲל֣וּ שָׁ֭מַיִם יֵרְד֣וּ תְהֹומֹ֑ות נַ֝פְשָׁ֗ם בְּרָעָ֥ה תִתְמֹוגָֽג׃

verses.ar: يَتَمَايَلُونَ وَيَتَرَنَّحُونَ مِثْلَ ٱلسَّكْرَانِ، وَكُلُّ حِكْمَتِهِمِ ٱبْتُلِعَتْ.
verses.kjv: They reel to and fro, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wits’ end.
verses.web: They reel back and forth, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wits’ end.
verses.he: יָחֹ֣וגּוּ וְ֭יָנוּעוּ כַּשִּׁכֹּ֑ור וְכָל־חָ֝כְמָתָ֗ם תִּתְבַּלָּֽע׃

verses.ar: فَيَصْرُخُونَ إِلَى ٱلرَّبِّ فِي ضِيقِهِمْ، وَمِنْ شَدَائِدِهِمْ يُخَلِّصُهُمْ.
verses.kjv: Then they cry unto the LORD in their trouble, and he bringeth them out of their distresses.
verses.web: Then they cry to Yahweh in their trouble, and he brings them out of their distress.
verses.he: וַיִּצְעֲק֣וּ אֶל־יְ֭הוָה בַּצַּ֣ר לָהֶ֑ם וּֽ֝מִמְּצֽוּקֹתֵיהֶ֗ם יֹוצִיאֵֽם׃

verses.ar: يُهْدِئُ ٱلْعَاصِفَةَ فَتَسْكُنُ، وَتَسْكُتُ أَمْوَاجُهَا.
verses.kjv: He maketh the storm a calm, so that the waves thereof are still.
verses.web: He makes the storm a calm, so that its waves are still.
verses.he: יָקֵ֣ם סְ֭עָרָה לִדְמָמָ֑ה וַ֝יֶּחֱשׁ֗וּ גַּלֵּיהֶֽם׃

verses.ar: فَيَفْرَحُونَ لِأَنَّهُمْ هَدَأُوا، فَيَهْدِيهِمْ إِلَى ٱلْمَرْفَإِ ٱلَّذِي يُرِيدُونَهُ.
verses.kjv: Then are they glad because they be quiet; so he bringeth them unto their desired haven.
verses.web: Then they are glad because it is calm, so he brings them to their desired haven.
verses.he: וַיִּשְׂמְח֥וּ כִֽי־יִשְׁתֹּ֑קוּ וַ֝יַּנְחֵ֗ם אֶל־מְחֹ֥וז חֶפְצָֽם׃

verses.ar: فَلْيَحْمَدُوا ٱلرَّبَّ عَلَى رَحْمَتِهِ وَعَجَائِبِهِ لِبَنِي آدَمَ.
verses.kjv: Oh that [men] would praise the LORD [for] his goodness, and [for] his wonderful works to the children of men!
verses.web: Let them praise Yahweh for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds for the children of men!
verses.he: יֹוד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה חַסְדֹּ֑ו וְ֝נִפְלְאֹותָ֗יו לִבְנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃

verses.ar: وَلْيَرْفَعُوهُ فِي مَجْمَعِ ٱلشَّعْبِ، وَلْيُسَبِّحُوهُ فِي مَجْلِسِ ٱلْمَشَايِخِ.
verses.kjv: Let them exalt him also in the congregation of the people, and praise him in the assembly of the elders.
verses.web: Let them exalt him also in the assembly of the people, and praise him in the seat of the elders.
verses.he: וִֽ֭ירֹמְמוּהוּ בִּקְהַל־עָ֑ם וּבְמֹושַׁ֖ב זְקֵנִ֣ים יְהַלְלֽוּהוּ׃

verses.ar: يَجْعَلُ ٱلْأَنْهَارَ قِفَارًا، وَمَجَارِيَ ٱلْمِيَاهِ مَعْطَشَةً،
verses.kjv: He turneth rivers into a wilderness, and the watersprings into dry ground;
verses.web: He turns rivers into a desert, water springs into a thirsty ground,
verses.he: יָשֵׂ֣ם נְהָרֹ֣ות לְמִדְבָּ֑ר וּמֹצָ֥אֵי מַ֝֗יִם לְצִמָּאֹֽון׃

verses.ar: وَٱلْأَرْضَ ٱلْمُثْمِرَةَ سَبِخَةً مِنْ شَرِّ ٱلسَّاكِنِينَ فِيهَا.
verses.kjv: A fruitful land into barrenness, for the wickedness of them that dwell therein.
verses.web: and a fruitful land into a salt waste, for the wickedness of those who dwell in it.
verses.he: אֶ֣רֶץ פְּ֭רִי לִמְלֵחָ֑ה מֵ֝רָעַ֗ת יֹ֣שְׁבֵי בָֽהּ׃

verses.ar: يَجْعَلُ ٱلْقَفْرَ غَدِيرَ مِيَاهٍ، وَأَرْضًا يَبَسًا يَنَابِيعَ مِيَاهٍ.
verses.kjv: He turneth the wilderness into a standing water, and dry ground into watersprings.
verses.web: He turns a desert into a pool of water, and a dry land into water springs.
verses.he: יָשֵׂ֣ם מִ֭דְבָּר לַֽאֲגַם־מַ֑יִם וְאֶ֥רֶץ צִ֝יָּ֗ה לְמֹצָ֥אֵי מָֽיִם׃

verses.ar: وَيُسْكِنُ هُنَاكَ ٱلْجِيَاعَ فَيُهَيِّئُونَ مَدِينَةَ سَكَنٍ.
verses.kjv: And there he maketh the hungry to dwell, that they may prepare a city for habitation;
verses.web: There he makes the hungry live, that they may prepare a city to live in,
verses.he: וַיֹּ֣ושֶׁב שָׁ֣ם רְעֵבִ֑ים וַ֝יְכֹונְנ֗וּ עִ֣יר מֹושָֽׁב׃

verses.ar: وَيَزْرَعُونَ حُقُولًا وَيَغْرِسُونَ كُرُومًا، فَتَصْنَعُ ثَمَرَ غَلَّةٍ.
verses.kjv: And sow the fields, and plant vineyards, which may yield fruits of increase.
verses.web: sow fields, plant vineyards, and reap the fruits of increase.
verses.he: וַיִּזְרְע֣וּ שָׂ֭דֹות וַיִּטְּע֣וּ כְרָמִ֑ים וַ֝יַּעֲשׂ֗וּ פְּרִ֣י תְבֽוּאָה׃

verses.ar: وَيُبَارِكُهُمْ فَيَكْثُرُونَ جِدًّا، وَلَا يُقَلِّلُ بَهَائِمَهُمْ.
verses.kjv: He blesseth them also, so that they are multiplied greatly; and suffereth not their cattle to decrease.
verses.web: He blesses them also, so that they are multiplied greatly. He doesn’t allow their livestock to decrease.
verses.he: וַיְבָרֲכֵ֣ם וַיִּרְבּ֣וּ מְאֹ֑ד וּ֝בְהֶמְתָּ֗ם לֹ֣א יַמְעִֽיט׃

verses.ar: ثُمَّ يَقِلُّونَ وَيَنْحَنُونَ مِنْ ضَغْطِ ٱلشَّرِّ وَٱلْحُزْنِ.
verses.kjv: Again, they are minished and brought low through oppression, affliction, and sorrow.
verses.web: Again, they are diminished and bowed down through oppression, trouble, and sorrow.
verses.he: וַיִּמְעֲט֥וּ וַיָּשֹׁ֑חוּ מֵעֹ֖צֶר רָעָ֣ה וְיָגֹֽון׃ ׆

verses.ar: يَسْكُبُ هَوَانًا عَلَى رُؤَسَاءَ، وَيُضِلُّهُمْ فِي تِيهٍ بِلَا طَرِيقٍ،
verses.kjv: He poureth contempt upon princes, and causeth them to wander in the wilderness, [where there is] no way.
verses.web: He pours contempt on princes, and causes them to wander in a trackless waste.
verses.he: שֹׁפֵ֣ךְ בּ֭וּז עַל־נְדִיבִ֑ים וַ֝יַּתְעֵ֗ם בְּתֹ֣הוּ לֹא־דָֽרֶךְ׃

verses.ar: وَيُعَلِّي ٱلْمِسْكِينَ مِنَ ٱلذُّلِّ، وَيَجْعَلُ ٱلْقَبَائِلَ مِثْلَ قُطْعَانِ ٱلْغَنَمِ.
verses.kjv: Yet setteth he the poor on high from affliction, and maketh [him] families like a flock.
verses.web: Yet he lifts the needy out of their affliction, and increases their families like a flock.
verses.he: וַיְשַׂגֵּ֣ב אֶבְיֹ֣ון מֵעֹ֑ונִי וַיָּ֥שֶׂם כַּ֝צֹּ֗אן מִשְׁפָּחֹֽות׃

verses.ar: يَرَى ذَلِكَ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمُونَ فَيَفْرَحُونَ، وَكُلُّ إِثْمٍ يَسُدُّ فَاهُ.
verses.kjv: The righteous shall see [it], and rejoice: and all iniquity shall stop her mouth.
verses.web: The upright will see it, and be glad. All the wicked will shut their mouths.
verses.he: יִרְא֣וּ יְשָׁרִ֣ים וְיִשְׂמָ֑חוּ וְכָל־עַ֝וְלָ֗ה קָ֣פְצָה פִּֽיהָ׃

verses.ar: مَنْ كَانَ حَكِيمًا يَحْفَظُ هَذَا، وَيَتَعَقَّلُ مَرَاحِمَ ٱلرَّبِّ.
verses.kjv: Whoso [is] wise, and will observe these [things], even they shall understand the lovingkindness of the LORD.
verses.web: Whoever is wise will pay attention to these things. They will consider the loving kindnesses of Yahweh.
verses.he: מִי־חָכָ֥ם וְיִשְׁמָר־אֵ֑לֶּה וְ֝יִתְבֹּֽונְנ֗וּ חַֽסְדֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
